source.author: stat
source.text: di bene, quod pugnas rapidum deiecit in amnem sanguinea Bellona manu: trahit unda timentes gurgite gentili, nuda nee flebilis umbra stridebit vestros Tydeus inhumatus ad ignes; ibitis aequoreis crudelia pabula monstris, illum terra vehit suaque in primordia solvet.
source.text_original: di bene, quod pugnas rapidum deiecit in amnem / sanguinea Bellona manu: trahit unda timentes / gurgite gentili, nuda nee flebilis umbra / stridebit vestros Tydeus inhumatus ad ignes; / ibitis aequoreis crudelia pabula monstris, / illum terra vehit suaque in primordia solvet.
source.text_english: Thanks to the gods, that Bellona with her bloody hand has hurled the battle into the rushing river: the wave, with its native whirlpool, drags away the fearful; naked and unwept, the shade of Tydeus, unburied, will not screech to your fires. You will go as cruel food for the sea monsters; the earth bears him and will resolve him back into its own first elements.

reuse.author: val
reuse.text: illa quidem fessis longe petit umida palmis vellera, sed bibulas urgenti pondere vestes unda trahit levique manus labuntur ab auro.
reuse.text_original: illa quidem fessis longe petit umida palmis / vellera, sed bibulas urgenti pondere vestes / unda trahit levique manus labuntur ab auro.
reuse.text_english: Indeed she reaches far with her weary hands for the moist fleece, but the wave, pressing with its heavy weight, draws down the thirsty garments, and her hands slip from the gleaming gold.
